[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Cjaalysce''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] colonist on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] and the daughter of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Leniel Beal]] who was responsible for the colonization of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She fell in love with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Iann Doaba]]. However, he exiled himself into the [[Doaba Badlands]] after murdering a rival for her love. After his departure, she was filled with grief, and had a painting drawn of her which visibly showed her grief. The painting was named "[[Tejha Larel]]," which was [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Old Corellian]] for "Undying Love". She went into the Badlands to try to find Doaba, but [[Death/Legends|died]] in the search. Doaba later found her corpse and died of grief. It was later rumored that Doaba's spirit haunted the painting.
